plan.diagnosis_summary: Node_3 carries a local shortcut: sensor_meta_v2 has near-complete label information there (mi_norm 1.0002 vs 0.0002-0.0008 on peers, robust_z 49.99); once excluded, node_3's label quality collapses (suspected_noise 0.2307, high_conf_conflict 0.1065, mean_self_confidence 0.3816) far above the healthy baseline (node_1 0.0445/0.0226/0.819, node_4 0.0408/0.0234/0.818), revealing localized label noise. Node_4 has a clean 1000x unit drift on byte/load columns (conservation median_ratio exactly 1000.0 for both primary laws, sbytes/sload/dbytes/dload anchors 914x/1010x/798x/762x), three schema aliases plus 413 physically corrupted rows. Node_1 and node_2 are legitimate Non-IID: node_1 is fully clean, and node_2's large anchor shifts (dur 17x, sinpkt 24x, rate 0.048x, ackdat/synack near-zero) are one-directional traffic-mixture effects from concentrating all globally rare classes (Analysis/Backdoor/Shellcode/Worms) while its primary conservation ratios stay exactly 1.0 and its label-noise metrics are only moderately above peers.
